services.name: Kids Jiu Jitsu
services.desc: By providing your phone number, you agree to receive text messages from Johns Gym. Message and data rates may apply. I’ve been to numerous Gyms and felt like a number or just a paying customer, even at times sort of feeling like an outcast to the other groups. But not here, this gym really is a family. From the first free trial class I attended to 3 months later, I regularly speak to my fellow gym members outside of class and have a real bond with everyone there. To make it even better, the coaches are so passionate about what they teach and work with everyone no matter the skill level of the student. I strongly recommend this gym to anyone looking to better their life in every way! I can’t
